messages:
Jake (ACME): Hey team — onboarding hit a weird pattern. Browser SDK preflight calls pass, but main generate requests from EU users get intermittent 429s within first 30s of ramp. Same API key, same machine, low QPS (~10).
Maya: Thanks Jake — is this only from a single EU region or across multiple POPs? Any client-side retries we should know about?
Jake (ACME): Looks like eu-west only. We have http2 keepalive enabled and long-lived connections from the client. No aggressive retries, just default SDK backoff.
Maya: Ok. Can you paste a minimal repro (curl) that hits the failing path? Also the SDK version.
Jake (ACME): sdk-js v1.4.2. Repro curl (works intermittently):
```
curl -i -N -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-***" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  https://api.redwood-hosted.net/v1/generate -d '{"model":"gpt-open-7b","input":"hi"}'
```
Maya: Quick checks: 1) try disabling http2/keepalive client-side to force new TLS sessions (sets connection reuse to false) 2) reduce parallel open streams (set maxConcurrentRequests=2) 3) enable jittered exponential backoff for 429s. Can you try and report results?
Jake (ACME): Tried disabling keepalive — error rate dropped a lot. With keepalive on: ~30% 429 on first 10-30s. With keepalive off: ~2% and then disappears.
Maya: That strongly suggests an edge connection/slot accounting bug where long-lived multiplexed connections from browsers are being counted against a per-socket rate window in the EU edge. I'll loop Eng.
Maya: @Olivia / @Ryan — heads-up: customer seeing EU-only early onboarding 429s reproducible with http2 keepalive. Disabling keepalive mitigates. Jake repro attached above.
Olivia: Thanks Maya — I see a correlated spike in connection multiplex metrics on the EU edge around that timeframe. Deploy bot shows a recent proxy tweak to conn slot accounting rolled two days ago. I'm deploying a small hotfix that changes per-stream accounting to per-request splay for keys with high keepalive reuse.
deploy-bot: hotfix rolled to eu-edge-proxy v2.14.3 at 5055501270 — routing traffic to patched hosts, no full restart.
Olivia: Can you test again in ~30s, Jake? Also, as a short-term workaround keep the SDK change (disable http2/keepalive) until we confirm. We'll follow-up with a permanent fix to avoid customer changes.
Jake (ACME): Retested — with hotfix 429s gone in EU. Thanks! We'll re-enable keepalive tomorrow and report. Really appreciate the quick turnaround :rocket:
Maya: Awesome — I'll log this as an onboarding edge-429 pattern and add a short troubleshooting note to the CS runbook: "If EU onboarding 429s + http2 keepalive => test with keepalive off; contact eng for edge hotfix".
Ryan: I'll follow up on a postmortem and add a regression test to the edge-proxy suite for long-lived http2 streams accounting.
Jake (ACME): Thanks all. I'll ping back if it flares when we re-enable.
